cues.en: Hey there.
cues.zh: 哈囉。

cues.en: This is Andre.
cues.zh: 我是 Andrei。

cues.en: You're about to dive into the course.
cues.zh: 你即將開始這門課。

cues.en: But here's the truth.
cues.zh: 但先說實話。

cues.en: Most people won't finish this course.
cues.zh: 大多數人不會完成這門課。

cues.en: Why?
cues.zh: 為什麼？

cues.en: It's because doing a course from the comfort of your home is going to take something away.
cues.zh: 因為在舒適的家裡上課，會少了一樣東西。

cues.en: That is one of the most critical parts of doing anything challenging and worthwhile.
cues.zh: 做任何有挑戰又值得的事情時，這一點都很關鍵。

cues.en: Accountability.
cues.zh: 就是相互督促、對自己的承諾負責。

cues.en: It's a lot harder to stop going to elementary school than to stop watching an online course.
cues.zh: 比起停止看線上課程，要停止上小學難得多。

cues.en: Right.
cues.zh: 對吧？

cues.en: But here's the thing.
cues.zh: 不過，

cues.en: There is a way to guarantee right now that you will finish the course and you will get through the XHTML courses no matter how hard they get.
cues.zh: 現在有個方法，能確保你完成這門課，不管 ZTM 課程變得多難，都能走下去。

cues.en: And trust me, it's going to get hard because we want to teach you really valuable skills.
cues.zh: 相信我，後面會有難度，因為要教你真正有價值的技能。

cues.en: And they are valuable because they're hard to acquire.
cues.zh: 它們有價值，正是因為不容易學會。

cues.en: And this is why you're here.
cues.zh: 這也是你來這裡的原因。

cues.en: If you don't finish the course, it's a waste of your money.
cues.zh: 沒有完成課程，就浪費了錢。

cues.en: But if you finish the course, we truly believe it will get you the skills that you want.
cues.zh: 但如果完成，我們相信你能取得想要的技能。

cues.en: So this is why you're going to do that.
cues.zh: 所以接下來要做這件事。

cues.en: Might put you outside your comfort zone, but it will be extremely effective in increasing your chances of success.
cues.zh: 可能會讓你走出舒適圈，但能有效提高成功機會。

cues.en: Ready for it?
cues.zh: 準備好了嗎？

cues.en: You're going to come join our online classroom.
cues.zh: 加入我們的線上教室。

cues.en: In the next lecture, I'll provide a private link only for XDR-TB students.
cues.zh: 下一堂會提供只有 ZTM 學生能使用的私人連結。

cues.en: In there, there are three things I will ask you to do.
cues.zh: 進去後，希望你做三件事。

cues.en: One is to introduce yourself to the community.
cues.zh: 第一，向社群自我介紹。

cues.en: You can share as little or as much as you want about yourself.
cues.zh: 想分享多少自己的資訊都可以。

cues.en: I'm going to finish x course by this date and put that date in your calendar to.
cues.zh: 告訴大家「我要在這個日期前完成某門課」，也把日期記進行事曆。

cues.en: Number two, go to Accountability Buddies channel.
cues.zh: 第二，到 Accountability Buddies 頻道。

cues.en: Oh, that's a that's a mouthful.
cues.zh: 這名字還真拗口。

cues.en: And find someone who is starting a team course right now at the same time.
cues.zh: 找一位也正在開始 ZTM 課程的人。

cues.en: It doesn't have to be the same course.
cues.zh: 不一定要同一門課。

cues.en: And you can have multiple partners.
cues.zh: 也可以找多位夥伴。

cues.en: You're going to make sure that you each finish the course and the goals you set out to do.
cues.zh: 互相確認對方完成課程，以及原先設定的目標。

cues.en: Finally, number three, hang out in the general chat and talk about anything that you want.
cues.zh: 最後，第三，到一般聊天區，聊任何想聊的事。

cues.en: You will also have course specific channels that you can chat in.
cues.zh: 也有各課專屬的頻道可以聊天。

cues.en: You want to be surrounded by other learners like you to stay motivated and being part of a class.
cues.zh: 與其他學習者相處，維持動力，感覺自己是班級的一員。

cues.en: Now in here, we're also going to have virtual hangout sessions with myself, other Zoom instructors and students.
cues.zh: 這裡也會舉辦線上聚會，由我、其他 ZTM 講師與學生參加。

cues.en: I recommend having the discourse server open as you go through the course and as you are learning.
cues.zh: 建議上課學習時，同時開著 Discord 伺服器。

cues.en: Now, I'm not saying this to sell you something.
cues.zh: 我不是想向你推銷什麼。

cues.en: This is simply a fact of learning.
cues.zh: 這只是學習的事實。

cues.en: When you learn in a group, when you surround yourself with other learners, when you have accountability, you are more likely to succeed.
cues.zh: 團體學習、身邊有其他學習者，而且有人相互督促時，更容易成功。

cues.en: It's a fact.
cues.zh: 這是事實。

cues.en: Finally throughout the course, as you encounter problems or challenges, don't give up.
cues.zh: 最後，課程中遇到問題或挑戰時，不要放棄。

cues.en: Come back to our Discord server and ask questions and get help.
cues.zh: 回到 Discord 伺服器提問、尋求協助。

cues.en: But most importantly, as you start to learn and grow your skills, come here and help out other students.
cues.zh: 更重要的是，技能逐漸成長後，也來幫助其他學生。

cues.en: Teaching and helping others is one of the best ways to retain the information you just learned.
cues.zh: 教導並幫助別人，是記住所學最好的方法之一。

cues.en: If you create this routine around your learning, opening up discord, start watching the lessons.
cues.zh: 建立這樣的學習習慣，先開 Discord，再開始看課程。

cues.en: Surround yourself with others that have similar goals to you.
cues.zh: 讓自己身邊都是目標相近的人。

cues.en: You will have the accountability and the support system to finish the course, I promise you.
cues.zh: 你就有完成課程所需的督促與支援系統，我保證。

cues.en: Oh, and another fun bit.
cues.zh: 還有一件有趣的事。

cues.en: When you finish the course, you post your certificate in the alumni channel to become an alumni.
cues.zh: 完成課程後，把證書貼到 Alumni 頻道，就能成為校友。

cues.en: And then, who knows?
cues.zh: 接著，誰知道呢？

cues.en: The people that really are stars of the community become star mentors.
cues.zh: 社群裡表現最出色的人，還會成為 Star Mentor。

cues.en: Ooh.
cues.zh: 喔。

cues.en: Now, this all may sound silly.
cues.zh: 這些聽起來可能有點傻。

cues.en: You may say that you don't need anybody.
cues.zh: 你也許覺得不需要任何人。

cues.en: But trust me, we've been doing this for many years, and there is this consistent trend of those that finish the course, get hired, and find success in their careers.
cues.zh: 但相信我，我們做了很多年，完成課程、獲聘並在職涯成功的人，一直有共同趨勢。

cues.en: You have to do the things that are uncomfortable sometimes to succeed.
cues.zh: 有時要做讓自己不舒服的事，才能成功。

cues.en: So that's it.
cues.zh: 就這樣。

cues.en: See you in the next lecture and see you in our community.
cues.zh: 下一堂見，也期待在社群見到你。
